machine: Apple M5, Chrome, ANGLE Metal, DPR 2

ads_transition.method: FOV sampled every animation frame after RMB down (docks, Jackal AR): ads = smoothstep of a linear clock over HANDLING.adsIn (0.2 s)

framePacing.method: __dev.perf(5) with RMB toggled every 0.35 s vs not

crouch.toggle: tap C: height 1.80 → 1.24 m in 0.5 s (exponential, rate 12), eye 1.62 → 1.16 m; tap again: back to 1.80

tokyo.note: 2 crouch-only cells on a metro stair under the street railing (Fountain Plaza): same stair, 0.25 m closer to its wall

stress.note: Tokyo crouched: one run (20 FPS, crouch then sprint-jump) ended overlapping a vaultable roof parapet while standing again (crouch 0 for the last 0.7 s): the standing controller's landing-frame overlap on vault colliders, met with a different timing; resolves the next frames. Two harness fixes found first: the solid-crossing detector assumed a standing body (11 false reports in the culvert), and a landing on the single idle frame (1).

arena_aim_ab.method: __dev.tdmSim bot vs bot, 25 tickets, 4 ALPHA vs 5 OMEGA (player spectating), 11.0 (aiming) alternated with { ads: false } (the 10.0 hip-only shooter) in one session; 3 + 3 matches per level

hitPctByRange.method: every round carries its mode and firing range; hits / rounds, summed over the 3 matches; [pct, rounds]

tuning_history: first build (aim over 13 m, no range cap, pushes at any range): hip rounds still had a 26-30 m median range (pushes and the frames before a decide); docks matches 195-207 s
+ gunners push only within 25 m, aiming also in hunt/advance on sight: 70% of rounds aimed, but docks 197-235 s and the desert a 50 m standoff (kill range median 46-51 m)
+ effective range 40 m (beyond it they sprint up, no fire): final numbers above

aiBench_survival.method: same session, alternated with main (10.0) served from a worktree on :5174
aiBench_survival.note: one earlier 11.0 Tokyo run read CPU 6.4 ms / AI 0.49 ms; every subsystem was 2x slower in it (the player update too), and the alternated rerun matched main: machine state, not the change

tactical_jungle.note: the same three failures on main (10.0): pre-existing, not 11.0 ('never took cover' in that scenario)
